title: 第0368章 告别岛民再赴主城第0367章 猫和同行探查主城遗迹
content_zh:
三日休整，转瞬即逝。
凰溪岛的晨光一如既往温柔，穿透薄薄的晨雾，洒满整座海岛。海面波光粼粼，度假区的街道早早苏醒，武者晨练的呼喝声、商铺开张的喧闹声、游客闲谈的笑语声交织在一起，一派岁月静好的盛世模样。
可只有贾黑米一行人清楚，这份祥和不过是浮于表面的虚妄。
海岛之外，废土异兽环伺，都市暗流汹涌。
海岛之下，地脉低语不休，封印隐患丛生。
短暂的休整，不是休憩安逸，而是为了更好的奔赴与战斗。
武道广场中心，今日早已人山人海。
得知贾黑米与才依依两位海岛天骄即将远赴主城求学，岛上几乎所有武道学员、普通居民、商铺店主尽数赶来，自发聚集相送。
这半年来，凰溪岛历经数次诡异暴乱、邪神渗透、考场阴谋，数次濒临危机。
是贾黑米横空出世，以孱弱废柴之身觉醒逆天心灵天赋，一次次净化诡异、破除侵蚀、揪出内鬼、守护海岛安宁。
是才依依以顶尖武道血脉镇场，争锋对决、稳压强敌，撑起海岛年轻一辈的荣光。
一支小队，以少年之躯，扛住了整座海岛的黑暗危机，保住了万千岛民的安稳生活。
于普通岛民而言，两人早已不是单纯的高考优胜者，而是凰溪岛的守护者，是这片边境土地最大的骄傲。
“黑米小兄弟，一路顺风！到了主城好好修炼，闯出咱们凰溪岛的名头！”
“依依小姐，一路平安！在外多加小心，莫要被主城的世家子弟欺负了去！”
“早点学成归来！咱们凰溪岛永远是你们的根！”
此起彼伏的呼喊声此起彼伏，真诚又热烈。无数居民挥手致意，眼底满是期许与不舍。
人群前方，几位海岛武道馆的馆长、本地武道协会的负责人齐齐伫立，神色郑重。
此前，岛内几大武道馆曾因循守旧、轻视贾黑米，甚至暗中偏袒世家子弟，暗藏私心。历经考场之乱、邪神渗透风波后，众人早已彻底改观，心中只剩敬佩与惭愧。
海岛武道协会会长上前一步，双手递出两枚封装精致的储物玉牌，语气诚恳：“贾同学、才同学，这是岛内武道联盟凑集的一点修炼物资，内含高阶气血药剂、基础封印符箓与秘境通行碎片，微薄心意，权当为两位天骄践行。”

“凰溪岛地小资源薄，帮不上大忙，只盼你们远赴主城，不忘初心，潜心修行，将来能护得一方安宁。”
贾黑米伸手接过玉牌，入手温润，内蕴精纯的灵气波动。他微微躬身，神色谦逊有礼：“多谢各位前辈厚爱。我与依依谨记本心，绝不会忘了凰溪岛，忘了这片养育我们的土地。”
褪去往日的青涩自卑，历经数次生死历练、风波淬炼，如今的他，沉稳内敛，气度俨然，已然有了强者风范。
才依依亦是微微颔首，清冷出声：“承蒙照拂，我等定不负海岛期许。”
两人的态度谦和温润，没有半分天骄傲气，引得四周岛民更是心生好感，赞叹声不绝于耳。
人群侧边，花呗呗抱着双臂，看着眼前温情满满的送别场面，嘴角噙着一抹浅笑。
她早已彻底清空了凰溪岛所有低端异能交易据点，盘点收拢了半年来所有的交易收益、稀有材料、侵蚀碎片与异能矿石。所有产业账目梳理完毕，遗留事务尽数交割妥当，一身轻松，无牵无挂。
凰溪岛的小市场，格局太小，束缚太大。
从今往后，她的舞台，是主城顶级黑市，是整个蓝星的异能交易圈层。
“人情味倒是挺足。”花呗呗低声轻笑，“比主城那些表面客套、背地里勾心斗角的世家圈层，舒服多了。”
主城繁华，也主城冰冷。
那里的情谊绑定着利益，交往裹挟着算计，远不如海岛民众这般纯粹热忱。
就在这时，一道黑影轻盈掠至众人肩头。
黑猫猫和身姿矫健，通体漆黑的毛发一尘不染，琥珀色竖瞳清亮幽深，带着彻夜探查后的沉稳。
它昨夜通宵穿梭凰溪岛连通主城的整条浅层地下水脉，走遍沿途分支脉络，排查了所有潜藏的异兽巢穴、诡异据点、低语密集区域，早已将路途隐患摸得一清二楚。
“前路浅层隐患已肃清。”
猫和人声清冷，精准汇报探查结果：“沿途三处低级异兽窝点、两处残留低语陷阱，尽数清除。主干道地脉稳定，封印波动平缓，短时间内不会出现大规模诡异爆发。”
“但我探查途中发现，越靠近主城方向，地下低语浓度越高，地脉封印壁垒越薄弱，暗流痕迹愈发密集。”
短短一句话，瞬间冲淡了现场的温情氛围，让众人心头再次绷紧心弦。
前路，从来不是坦途。

看似安稳的主城求学路，底下暗藏着足以颠覆一切的凶险。
content_en:
Three days of rest, fleeting.
The morning light on Huangxi Island is as gentle as ever, penetrating the thin morning mist and filling the entire island. The sea surface is sparkling, and the streets of the resort area wake up early. The shouts of warriors doing morning exercises, the noise of shops opening, and the laughter of tourists chatting are intertwined, giving it a peaceful and prosperous look.
But only Jiahemi and his party knew that this peace was nothing but an illusion on the surface.
Outside the island, the wasteland is surrounded by strange beasts, and the city's undercurrents are turbulent.
Under the island, the earth's veins whisper endlessly, and the seals are full of hidden dangers.
A short rest is not to rest and relax, but to rush and fight better.
The center of Martial Arts Plaza was already crowded with people today.
Knowing that the two island geniuses Jia Heimi and Cai Yiyi were about to go to the main city to study, almost all the martial arts students, ordinary residents, and shop owners on the island came and spontaneously gathered to see them off.
In the past six months, Huangxi Island has experienced several strange riots, evil gods infiltration, examination room conspiracies, and has been on the verge of crisis several times.
It was Jia Heimi who was born out of nowhere, awakening his heaven-defying spiritual talent in a weak and useless body, purifying weirdness, breaking erosion, uncovering the inner ghost, and protecting the peace of the island time and time again.
It was Cai Yiyi who controlled the battlefield with the blood of top martial arts, competed against each other, suppressed powerful enemies, and supported the glory of the younger generation of the island.
A small team, with their young bodies, withstood the dark crisis on the entire island and preserved the stable lives of thousands of islanders.
For ordinary islanders, the two are no longer just college entrance examination winners, but the guardians of Huangxi Island and the greatest pride of this border land.
"Have a nice journey, little brother Heimei! When you get to the main city, practice hard and make a name for yourself on Huangxi Island!"
"Miss Yiyi, have a safe journey! Be careful out there and don't get bullied by the children of the aristocratic families in the main city!"
"Come back soon after completing your studies! Our Huangxi Island will always be your roots!"
The shouts came one after another, sincere and enthusiastic. Countless residents waved greetings, their eyes filled with anticipation and reluctance.
In front of the crowd, several directors of the Island Martial Arts Hall and the heads of local martial arts associations stood together with solemn expressions.
Previously, several major martial arts gyms on the island had followed the old ways, looked down on Jia Heimi, and even secretly favored the children of aristocratic families, hiding their selfish motives. After experiencing the chaos in the examination room and the turmoil of the evil god's infiltration, everyone has completely changed their outlook, leaving only admiration and shame in their hearts.
The president of the Island Martial Arts Association took a step forward, handed out two exquisitely encapsulated storage jade tokens with both hands, and said in a sincere tone: "Classmate Jia, Classmate Cai, these are some training materials gathered by the Island Martial Arts Alliance. They contain high-level qi and blood potions, basic sealing talismans, and secret realm passage fragments. I should honor these two geniuses with my small kindness."
"Huangxi Island is small and has few resources, so I can't help much. I only hope that you will go to the main city, not forgetting your original intention, and practicing with concentration, so that you can protect peace in the future."
Jia Heimi reached out and took the jade token, which was warm and filled with pure spiritual energy. He bowed slightly, with a humble and courteous expression: "Thank you all for your love, seniors. Yiyi and I will keep our true intentions in mind and will never forget Huangxi Island and the land that raised us."
The youthful and inferior self-esteem of the past has faded away, and after several life and death experiences and storms, he is now calm and restrained, with a clear demeanor, and he already has the demeanor of a strong man.
Cai Yiyi also nodded slightly and said coldly: "Thanks to your care, we will definitely live up to the island's expectations."
The two people's attitudes were modest and gentle, without any hint of arrogance, which made the surrounding islanders even more fond of them and praised them endlessly.
To the side of the crowd, Hua Beibei crossed her arms and looked at the tender farewell scene in front of her, with a slight smile on her lips.
She has already completely emptied all the low-end supernatural power trading strongholds on Huangxi Island, taking stock of all the trading proceeds, rare materials, erosion fragments and supernatural ores in the past six months. All the property accounts have been sorted out, and all the remaining matters have been settled properly, making you feel relaxed and worry-free.
Small market on Huangxi IslandThe market structure is too small and the constraints are too great.
From now on, her stage will be the top black market in the main city and the entire Blue Star's ability trading circle.
"It's quite humane." Hua Beibei chuckled softly, "It's much more comfortable than the circles of aristocratic families in the main city that are polite on the surface but scheming behind the scenes."
The main city is prosperous, but also the main city is cold.
The friendships there are tied to interests, and interactions are wrapped up in calculations. They are far less pure and enthusiastic than the people on the island.
At this moment, a black shadow lightly passed over everyone's shoulders.
The black cat has a strong figure, its dark hair is spotless, and its amber vertical pupils are clear and deep, with a calmness after exploring all night.
It traveled through the entire shallow underground water vein connecting Huangxi Island to the main city last night, walked through the branch veins along the way, and checked out all the hidden nests of strange beasts, strange strongholds, and areas with dense whispers. It had already clearly understood the hidden dangers on the road.
"The superficial hidden dangers on the road ahead have been eliminated."
Mao Heren's voice was cold, and he accurately reported the detection results: "Three low-level alien beast dens and two residual whispering traps along the way have been eliminated. The main road's ground veins are stable, the seal fluctuations are gentle, and there will be no large-scale strange outbreaks in a short period of time."
"But during my investigation, I found that the closer to the main city, the higher the concentration of underground whispers, the weaker the earth seal barrier, and the denser the undercurrent traces."
This short sentence instantly diluted the warm atmosphere of the scene and made everyone's hearts tighten again.
The road ahead is never smooth.
The seemingly stable path to study in the main city hides dangers that can subvert everything.
